description:
List the real cookie categories belonging to a site. Use this before consentease_add_cookie to obtain a categoryId; never guess category IDs.

Args:
  - id (string): The site id.

Returns JSON: { "data": [{ "id", "name", "displayName", "isRequired", "isEnabled" }] }.
Another account's site is hidden with not_found. Requires scope: sites:read.

id.description: The ConsentEase site id (UUID) the cookie belongs to.

name: consentease_list_categories
title: List a site's cookie categories
